title: ID-Free Predictive Audiences Drive Efficient Reach at Scale Across CTV
summary: See how using Comscore Predictive Audiences through Magnite SpringServe can achieve greater targeting efficiency with ID-free CTV targeting.
body_markdown: Compared with ID-based audiences in the campaign, Predictive Audiences delivered the target audience 43% more efficiently, allowing more of the advertiser’s budget to go toward working media while maintaining performance.
